1924, April
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1.
Page 8 Cont. April 24
Misunderstanding Michael O'Connor & Catherine friends and lovers
24 John Kelly -154 - E. 92 St. Upsetting peace of family - Mother & Sisters brokenhearted at his unreasonable ways. April 25th Anoth- er Sister of his - besides the one who enrolled him reports this evening a favorable change in said brothers conduct. Now gentle to and loving to Mother and Sisters. Real
June 18 April 26 Daniel Birmingham - 63 - E. 130 St. Drinking, having had cara- buncle Enrolled by anxious daughter Susan
27 Daniel S. Hederman 200 - E. 115. Nervous and worried - mind not settled joins perpetually
May 1 Mary Garrity, 15 of 121 - E. 115 Sickly since a child, leaking heart-valve for last 3 yrs. quite weak this evening when enrolled perpetually.
4 Susanne Besold - wild - causing mother quite a little anxiety - enrolled for 4 yrs.
5th Promoter Miss K (of Bayonne N.J . ) S.M. A. writes from Roosevelt School Bayonne, N.J ." ..... and Chas D- of Bayonne for one year. I think it most advisable for this last one to be enrolled at once and not wait till meeting Sunday. He is out on probation." (Envolved in case of theft) Next day same promoter writes, "Charles D. ---- starting to make restitution: promises to make good in short time for everything." M. Bonner tells him though she might have him in Jail, that prayers are being offered for his reform. Tears came into his eyes as he himself admitted that a strange in- fluence has come over him. He has promised to give up drinking and bad company". Relatives seemed to have lost hopes in the possibility of his reform. "Father, what influence prayers have over a person!"
Page 9 May 7th Alice Robinson 11 yrs sad case of (Vitus dance) came - is enrolled for 2 yrs.
7 George Diffley 88 King St. good lad till two years ago - now ab- sent since. phones to Mother once in a while, even weeps but does not show up to Mother or wife or beautiful children; is enrolled To-day May 7th for one year.
